DEGENERATIVE DISC DISEASE PAIN RELIEF.

Degenerative disc disease (DDD), also known as spondylosis, is a common result of the aging process. 

Not every case of DDD  will cause debilitating pain, but the process may cause certain affects that will impact daily life, including less flexibility due to joint stiffness.

👉 These stretches are geared towards helping relieve some of the painful symptoms caused by DDD. 

👉 They may help improve lost flexibility (and muscle strength) and aid in better support of the spine.

SINGLE KNEE TO THE CHEST:
1️⃣ Lie flat on back.
2️⃣ Bring one leg towards chest, while the other leg remains straight as possible.
3️⃣ Hold for 15-30 seconds.
4️⃣ Relax and repeat 3-5 times. 

DOUBLE KNEE TO THE CHEST:
1️⃣ Lie flat on back.
2️⃣ Bring both legs towards chest.
3️⃣ Hold for 15-30 seconds.
4️⃣ Relax and repeat 3-5 times. 

LUMBAR ROTATION:
1️⃣ Lie flat on bacl.
2️⃣ Bend knees, keep feet flat.
3️⃣ Slowly, bend towards one side until a good stretch is felt.
4️⃣ Hold 2-3 seconds, return to starting position, and repeat on other side.
5️⃣ Do 10-15 complete cycles.
NOTE: keep the hips/bottom flat as possible! Only rotate the legs, don't twist the torso.
